summary: Both stage files pin kube-coder-tunnel-reclaim to :2565, the newest build (same digest as latest). The chart has no default, required-guards the key and pulls IfNotPresent. Five mutations show the render gate catches a regression, and the promote job and the pin writer both handle the new key. One advisory comment inaccuracy.
